key.name: panel-position
key.description: Position of the media controls indicator in the panel (left, center, right)

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Index within the chosen panel area (-1 = automatic)

key.name: show-track-name
key.description: Display track title next to the panel icon while media is playing

key.name: show-artist
key.description: Append the artist name to the track title shown in the panel

key.name: separator-text
key.description: Text inserted between the track title and artist name in the panel label

key.name: panel-label-width
key.description: Visible pixel width of the scrolling track label in the top panel. Changes apply immediately without a restart.

key.name: enable-panel-scroll
key.description: Scroll the track/artist label in the top panel. When off, text is truncated with an ellipsis.

key.name: scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of panel text scrolling: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: max-title-length
key.description: Maximum characters shown in the panel label when scrolling is disabled

key.name: panel-element-order
key.description: Comma-separated order of panel elements. Valid values: icon, label, controls. Example: "label,icon,controls". Changes apply immediately.

key.name: panel-font-family
key.description: Font family for the panel track/artist label. Empty string = inherit from shell theme.

key.name: panel-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the panel track/artist label.

key.name: panel-font-bold
key.description: Render the panel label text in bold weight.

key.name: panel-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the panel label text (e.g. "#ffffff" or "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"). Empty = inherit from shell theme.

key.name: panel-icon-size
key.description: Pixel size of the application icon shown in the top panel.

key.name: popup-title-font-family
key.description: Font family for the track-title label in the popup player. Empty = inherit.

key.name: popup-title-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the popup track-title.

key.name: popup-title-font-bold
key.description: Render the popup title in bold weight.

key.name: popup-title-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the popup title. Empty = inherit from theme.

key.name: popup-artist-font-family
key.description: Font family for the artist-name label in the popup player. Empty = inherit.

key.name: popup-artist-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the popup artist label.

key.name: popup-artist-font-bold
key.description: Render the popup artist label in bold weight.

key.name: popup-artist-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the popup artist label. Empty = inherit from theme.

key.name: tab-icon-size
key.description: Icon size used in the multi-player switcher tabs. 0 means follow the system / shell-theme default (currently 18 px).

key.name: single-icon-size
key.description: Icon size used when only one player is active (the large centred icon). 0 means follow the system default (currently 28 px).

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the popup media-player panel in pixels. Height scales proportionally with the album-art size.

key.name: enable-title-scroll
key.description: Scroll long track titles inside the popup media player

key.name: title-scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of title scrolling in the popup: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: enable-artist-scroll
key.description: Scroll long artist names inside the popup media player

key.name: artist-scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of artist scrolling in the popup: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: info-align-center
key.description: When true the track title and artist are centred under the album art. When false they are left-aligned. Changes apply immediately.

key.name: popup-button-order
key.description: Comma-separated order of popup control buttons. Valid ids: shuffle, previous, play, next, repeat. Changes apply immediately.

key.name: vinyl-app-ids
key.description: List of desktop-entry IDs for which the rotating vinyl record effect is active.

key.name: vinyl-app-disabled-ids
key.summary: Apps with vinyl effect explicitly disabled
key.description: List of desktop-entry IDs that have been seen and explicitly disabled by the user.

key.name: vinyl-app-instances
key.description: JSON-encoded list of {id, name, desktopId, busName, enabled} objects representing stored player instances.

key.name: enable-album-art-rotation
key.description: Spin the album art as a vinyl record while music plays; pauses when paused, stops when stopped

key.name: album-art-rotation-speed
key.description: Seconds per full rotation: 5 = fastest, 60 = slowest

key.name: tonearm-parked-angle
key.description: Angle in degrees of the tonearm when music is paused or stopped (resting position). Higher = further from disc.

key.name: tonearm-playing-angle
key.description: Angle in degrees of the tonearm when music is actively playing (tip resting on groove). Lower = closer to centre.

key.name: vinyl-click-count
key.description: Number of rapid clicks on the album art required to toggle the vinyl record effect for the current app

key.name: lyrics-click-count
key.description: Number of rapid clicks on the album art required to open or close the synced lyrics panel

key.name: enable-lyrics
key.description: Fetch and display time-synced lyrics from lrclib.net.

key.name: hide-default-player
key.description: Hide the built-in GNOME Shell media player controls from the date/time menu. Fully restored when the extension is disabled.

key.name: player-filter-mode
key.description: 0 = off (allow all), 1 = blacklist (exclude listed), 2 = whitelist (only allow listed)

key.name: player-filter-list
key.description: Comma-separated list of MPRIS short names to include or exclude depending on the filter mode
